concept: Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: visual direction for the existing Puffer Poker browser game. Reference image: the attached current six-seat poker screenshot, for layout and function only. Create one beautiful, practical desktop game UI mockup that improves this same game, not a website landing page. Preserve six stack badges around a large oval red poker table, oversized readable white playing cards in the middle and human hole cards at bottom center, a compact betting console below, and the Learn the hand odds sidebar on the right. Art direction: sophisticated casino card room, rich oxblood red woven felt, dark charcoal outside the table, padded dark leather rail with a delicate champagne brass edge and stitching, restrained warm lighting, soft realistic contact shadows. Crisp contemporary typography and high contrast ivory stack badges; distinctive teal for the active human and muted gold for the winner. Quiet folded seats, visibly actionable buttons, clear numerical hierarchy. Preserve the sparse practical information density. Text examples: 'PUFFER POKER', 'One pair, fours', 'Your turn', 'Fold', 'Check', 'BET 3 BB'. Frame as a straight-on full-screen playable UI screenshot, landscape. Avoid neon, purple gradients, ornamental flourishes, crowded labels, tiny unreadable text, chips covering cards, 3D camera perspective, avatars or decorative props. The goal is tactile, clean and convincing.
